name: Iluvatar CoreX MR-V100 (Zhikai 100) HBM inference card
memory_bandwidth_basis: None available, verified. Iluvatar publishes memory TYPE and CAPACITY on this card - '32 GB HBM2E' for the MR-V100, '16 GB HBM2E' for the MR-V50 - and publishes NO bandwidth figure, no bus width and no pin rate. NO FIGURE WAS BACK-COMPUTED FROM BANDWIDTH. Note the contrast with the BI-V100, where the vendor prints the same 64 GB/s figure for host and device links and it is therefore an interconnect number, not memory bandwidth; nothing on this page offers a memory bandwidth at all. Sources cn-iluvatar-zhikai100 and w5a-iluvatar-bi-v100-vendor-says-32gb-dram-hbm2 (recorded for the split).
notes: CREATED BY THE SPLIT of iluvatar-bi-v100-mr-v100 on 2026-10-05, which held BI-V100 and MR-V100 in one record with a single memory_type. The two differ in memory technology (HBM2 vs HBM2E), power (250 W vs 150 W), slot width (dual vs single), role (training vs inference) and release year (2021 vs 2022), and the schema holds one memory_type per record, so a single record could not state either part correctly. WHY THE SPLIT IS WORTH MAKING RATHER THAN ANNOTATING: this card is the reason Iluvatar is in this repo at all. It ships HBM on an INFERENCE-ONLY card. The 产品规格 table, verbatim: '内存 | 16 GB HBM2E' (智铠50加速卡 MR-V50, '半长半高单槽 PCle 卡', '板级功耗 75W') and '32 GB HBM2E' (智铠100加速卡 MR-V100, '全长全高单槽 PCle', '板级功耗 150W'), interface 'PCle Gen4.0 X 16 lane'. Every other Chinese inference part in this repo is LPDDR - MLU370 at 307 GB/s, Ascend 310P at 204.8 GB/s - and even Moore Threads' S4000 is GDDR6, not HBM. HBM2E at inference power and inference pricing is a genuinely different proposition. NO COMPUTE FIGURE, verified on this pass: the 产品特点 section claims '相较于市场上现有主流产品，智铠100将提供2-3倍的实际使用性能' - 2-3x the actual real-world performance of existing mainstream products - and '平均迁移时间相较市场主流产品下降50%以上', plus '支持FP32、FP16、INT8等多精度推理混合计算' naming supported precisions with no number attached to any. flops stays EMPTY. A '2-3x' claim against an unnamed mainstream product is not a figure and must not become one. SPARSITY: no footnote, no '2:4', no sparsity wording. Moot, and recorded so a future reader does not assume a figure exists to be halved. OTHER VENDOR FACTS: multimedia - '最大128路视频解码（H.264@1080P 30 fps）', '支持H.264/H.265/VP9/AVS2', 'JPEG图像解码/编码：2000/500 帧（HD）'; '兼容CUDA生态'; 800+ general instructions; 200+ supported models on the training sibling. PROCESS NODE IS NULL because this page does not print one - the 7 nm figure belongs to the BI-V100, and carrying it over to this part would be exactly the kind of quiet inheritance this split exists to stop. MEMORY_BUS_WIDTH: STILL NULL, no vendor width or pin rate published, and NO FIGURE WAS BACK-COMPUTED FROM BANDWIDTH.
